audit.why: 47.39% over 306 games with TRICKY 7.5/10 fits a zone lane K'Sante survives and then wins in teamfights. Sample is small but the shape is right.
audit.corrected: Ratings left; six chart rows brought onto the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven level-chart rows disagreed with the packet AND with the content layer's own whys. win[0] said Heimerdinger while whys[0] says 'it is a wash'; win[1] said Skill while whys[1] says 'I cannot answer the chip yet'; win[2] and win[3] said K'Sante while whys[2] says 'he zones me out of last-hits' and whys[3] says 'he banks poke leads'; win[4] said Heimerdinger while whys[4] calls 6 'my one even window'; win[5] said K'Sante while whys[5] says 'his zone [is] hardest here'.
audit.why: This lane has exactly one shape: Heimerdinger owns everything from level 2 to the first item, level 6 is the one even swing, and K'Sante takes over at two items. The chart said almost the opposite of the paragraph beneath it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 4 flipped to Skill, rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 to Heimerdinger, each as a matched full/content pair, ratings adjusted, and every why rewritten to state the mechanism.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabrications and a missing number. (1) 'R's terrain-shred' / 'shred the terrain his turrets hide behind' appears four times across the content layer. All Out does NOT shred terrain. Riot's text: K'Sante 'knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path' — the wall is used, not destroyed, and turrets do not hide behind terrain in the first place. (2) 'Q3 knockup' — Ntofo Strikes' second stack is a shockwave that PULLS. (3) The full layer gives CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade no cooldown despite it being the single ability that decides every dive.
audit.why: The grenade is a FLAT 11 seconds at every rank — it does not scale down, which makes 'bait it, then commit' a clean and permanent rule rather than a level-dependent guess. Micro-Rockets are 11/10/9/8/7s. Only a DIRECT hit stuns; the surrounding units are slowed, which is worth knowing before you decide whether to eat it.
audit.corrected: Terrain-shred replaced with the real wall-launch in whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid and wants.you[0]; the pull corrected in early and wants.foe[1]; the grenade's flat 11s and direct-hit-only stun written into tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and three chart rows.

notes: The headline fabrication: four strings claim K'Sante's R has a 'terrain-shred' that strips the cover Heimerdinger's turrets hide behind. All Out does not destroy terrain — Riot's text says it launches the target THROUGH a wall — and turrets do not use terrain cover at all. Replaced with the real interaction, which is actually better advice: R strands him away from his nest. The kit file's derived 'terrain: creates terrain' flag on K'Sante's R misfires against Riot's own description, so I did not assert it anywhere. Six of seven chart rows contradicted both the packet and the content prose beside them; flipped as matched pairs. Best concrete number this page was missing: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a FLAT 11s at every rank, so 'bait the grenade, then dive' never changes as the lane scales.
